title: GET status/series response
description: Single source of truth for series_response()'s shape in status.py. `data` restates no shape of its own: it $refs status_payload.schema.json's Reliability/HostMetrics/Bedrock/PanelError defs by relative path, since a panned single-range payload is exactly one of those subtrees. No $id, unlike status_payload.schema.json: an $id here would win over this file's own retrieval location as the base URI for its relative $refs.

end.description: iso(end) -- the requested end, echoed back after clamping/parsing.
